contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [CO]NSTAN S PF AVG ; R/ [VIC]TORIAE DD AVGGQ NN

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constans (333-350), Two Victories issue of 347-348, Trier mint, RIC vol. 8 page 151 no. 190. A grey surface may hint at a silver wash. Obverse description: Bust pearl diademed draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [CO]NSTAN S PF AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreaths; C in field between Victories. Reverse inscription:…
